北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴冷，体感仅 1℃。出门多穿点，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and chilly, feels like 1℃. Dress warmly when you go out!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云有点湿冷，体感 7℃。记得添衣，注意保暖防潮。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and humid, feels like 7℃. Remember to add layers and stay warm.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，气温 11℃。体感 9℃ 还是有点凉，添衣别感冒哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, 11℃. Feels a bit cool at 9℃, layer up to avoid catching a cold.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 29℃ 有点闷热。记得多喝水，防晒避暑哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, feels stuffy at 29℃. Remember to drink water and stay cool.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，气温 23℃，湿度较高。出门带伞，注意防潮。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, 23℃ with high humidity. Carry an umbrella and mind the dampness.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾，能见度低，体感 9℃。出行注意安全，记得添衣。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy with low visibility, feels like 9℃. Be careful when traveling, and dress warmly.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴冷，湿度 100% 体感 7℃。注意防湿保暖，别着凉。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and cold, 100% humidity feels like 7℃. Stay warm and dry, avoid catching a cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 15℃ 舒适。但昼夜温差大，早晚注意添衣。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels comfortable at 15℃. Mind the temperature difference between day and night, dress accordingly.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天有点凉，体感 10℃。多穿点，注意保暖防寒哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and a bit chilly, feels like 10℃. Dress warmly and stay cozy.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴冷，体感 7℃。注意添衣保暖，别让寒风吹着哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and cold, feels like 7℃. Remember to layer up and stay warm, avoid the chilly wind.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感 17℃ 比较舒适。傍晚出门，注意温差。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and comfortable at 17℃. If you go out in the evening, mind the temperature change.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒，体感 -12℃。全副武装，注意防冻保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feels like -12℃. Bundle up completely and stay warm to prevent frostbite!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴冷，体感 -3℃。记得多穿，防寒保暖最重要。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and cold, feels like -3℃. Remember to dress warmly and stay protected from the cold.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 15℃ 宜人。阳光虽好，风力不小，注意防晒。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and pleasant at 15℃. Enjoy the sun, but mind the wind and sun protection.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，体感 21℃ 潮湿。出门小心，注意交通安全。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy, feels humid at 21℃. Be careful when going out, mind traffic safety.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，体感 5℃ 还是挺凉的。多穿件外套，享受阳光。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny and quite cool at 5℃. Put on a jacket and enjoy the sunshine.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有霾，体感 -4℃ 寒冷。注意防护保暖，减少外出。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is hazy and very cold at -4℃. Protect yourself and stay warm, limit outdoor activities.
